discourse.title: Fill the world with love
discourse.excerpt: Sai sevaks have to develop the love in them, share it with others and fill the whole world with love.
discourse.theme: Love is not private feeling alone — develop it within, share it with others, and fill the whole world with love.

reflection: Swami's instruction is practical, not abstract: love grows by being developed inside and then shared outside. Today, share love in one concrete way — a kind word to someone you usually pass by, or help offered without being asked — and let that be your small share of filling the world with love. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 28, 18 Nov 1995)
seva_nudge: Share one act of love today with no expectation in return — cook a little extra and share a meal with a neighbour who lives alone.
